analysis.insight_summary: Users face confusion with marker flag mapping between [product_name] modules and [product_name] software, especially when integrating visualization panels. The problem stems from [company_name]'s inconsistent address notation between platforms, making it difficult to configure tag addresses reliably. This inconsistency complicates setup and adds to the learning curve in environments with multiple [company_name] devices.
